verdict.rationale: Together AI documents native function/tool calling with explicit support for multi-step (chained) and multi-turn agentic tool use, positioned as the foundation for agent loops (together-ai-docs-8,9,15,16). However, there is no independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability of parallel tool calls or that it avoids breakage across open models in practice — only first-party docs. missing for 10: independent benchmarks or community reports on parallel tool-call accuracy, explicit parallel tool-calling documentation, and hands-on verification that agent loops don't break on open models.
